notes.title: Homura Hime Playable at TGS 2025 & Voice Cast Announcement!
notes.content:
It's finally here.
 
 Homura Hime will be shown in playable form at Japan's largest video game event, Tokyo Game Show 2025!
 An acrylic stand of the heroine, Homura Hime, will be available as a play bonus.
 
 Plus, we can now confirm that Japanese voice acting will be implemented for the main characters!
 This is only a portion of the characters at present, but we are happy to announce the voice cast.
 The playable demo will also feature voiced characters in Japanese, so do check them out while you're on site.
 
 Homura Hime: Tomori Kusunoki
 Ann: Manaka Iwami
 Agasa: Hana Hishikawa
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41832760/963bfcab389d727e514981dd0a0025cb99f794b5.png[/img]
 We are also happy to announce a projected release date of this coming winter!
 Please wait a little longer for the exact date, but it will be announced in the coming days.

notes.title: Homura Hime to Release in Early 2025!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The 3D action game Homura Hime is set to release in early 2025!

Alongside Homura Hime, fight against archdemons possessed by deviant emotions, and get closer to discovering the truth behind both the archdemons and her own veiled legacy. Dodge enemy barrages from all directions and engage in tense, exhilarating combat.

Don't forget to check out the gameplay trailer if you haven't already!

notes.title: Homura Hime Demo Shown at BitSummit Drift!
notes.content:
Homura Hime is currently being shown at BitSummit Drift, an indie game event held at Miyako Messe, Kyoto.
The demo contains a world-premiere boss battle, allowing players to experience more of Homura Hime early.
If you're in the area, please stop by to try out the tense and exhilarating battle system!

[previewyoutube=oXZ8YTrezlo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Homura Hime Release Date Postponed
notes.content:
First of all, we wish everyone a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
Thank you for your continuous support for Homura Hime.
It's thanks to your support that the game and the crimsondusk team could come so far.

However, we come with some disappointing news.
After careful consideration and evaluation, we came to the conclusion that in order to meet everyone's expectations towards Homura Hime, we need to spend more time and effort on the game than initially planned.

Therefore, the release date for Homura Hime has been postponed.

We deeply apologize for failing to deliver on the previously announced 2023 release date.
This decision was made in order to improve the quality of the game. We will do our utmost to provide players with a polished game experience right out of the bat.


Once again, we apologize for the delay. Thank you for your patience and understanding.
We will continue to work hard to provide the adventure everyone is waiting for in Homura Hime.
As always, we will announce any new information via Steam News and on our social media accounts.

crimsondusk

notes.title: Get ready for The Nightmarket Festival 2022!
notes.content:
Homura Hime is proud to be participating in The Nightmarket Festival! Add it to your wishlist today !

The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is showcasing around 100 discounted games as well as offering free demos for dozens of hot upcoming titles!

The sale runs from Aug 4-8 10am PST and includes live broadcasts to celebrate and showcase the lineup.

The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is the first-ever Steam sales event focusing on promoting games from the SEA region. It aims to break cultural barriers and raise awareness for the region’s gaming scene, introducing awesome games with a local touch; much like the night market culture commonly seen here -- filled with creativity, diversity, and great fun.

Get your appetite ready and enjoy a diverse taste of unique SEA games! Forget the scorching weather, the party’s indoors! We got your weekend covered!
